experiment: Protein torsion ordering for RSNN_TRSF on PDBbind-Benchmark identity30
goal: Reorder the protein prefix so consecutive-atom dihedrals become REAL torsions (backbone phi/psi/omega + side-chain chi1..chiN), instead of the current all-atom (residue_id, PDB-order) sequence whose quadruplets are a hodgepodge (one N-CA-C-O per residue + carbonyl->sidechain + boundary noise). Ablate protein_order=torsion vs allatom.
status: RUNNING. Implemented + verified (209 pytest pass; correctness independently confirmed: 216 real spine dihedrals == phi/psi/omega to <1e-15 rad, chi-path == chi1..chiN on real Lys/Met/Arg, gating leaks nothing). Cache augmented (0 fallbacks). SLURM job 68270544 (dym-lab2, 3 A40): torsion 3 seeds training. Results pending.

decisions.Q1_token_layout: One sequence = [backbone spine] ++ [per-residue sidechain runs] ++ [ligand walk]. N/CA repeated to anchor each side-chain run (so chi1=N-CA-CB-CG is a consecutive quadruplet). RSNN scatter-mean node aggregation absorbs the repeats.
decisions.Q2_backbone_continuity: Pockets are the 8A interface, ~22% of consecutive residues NOT peptide-bonded (median ~7 backbone fragments/pocket). Split the spine into contiguous fragments at ||C(i)-N(i+1)|| >= 1.8A; reset ALL THREE feature streams (edge-window, angle, dihedral) at every segment boundary.
decisions.Q3_chi_precision: Approximate, no raw-PDB: linearize side chain to first atom per Greek level (atom_positions codes B,G,D,E,Z,H, un-dropped from the .pkl). Exact chi for linear residues (Lys/Arg/Met/Glu/Gln/Ser/Cys/...); near-canonical for branched (PDB lists the '1' atom first). Branch/duplicate atoms kept as TOKENS in a reset tail (no dihedral off them).
decisions.Q4_carbonyl_O: Spine = N,CA,C only (no torsion needs O). O goes in the per-residue reset tail (token only) - preserves H-bond-acceptor identity without re-breaking psi/omega.
decisions.Q5_degenerate_residues: General rule, no special-casing: Gly -> empty chi (len-2 anchor); Ala -> len-3 chi path (angle only); Pro -> linear path, ignore N-CD ring bond; incomplete residues -> break spine, emit side chain if CA+CB present. A segment computes a dihedral only where it has >=4 atoms, an angle where >=3.
decisions.Q6_logistics: Ablation flag --protein_order {allatom(default, byte-identical), torsion}; deterministic torsion order precomputed once + cached (augment_cache_with_torsion); residue-granular truncation (drop whole farthest-from-ligand residues, keep segments intact).

results.verdict: HURTS. torsion 0.5483 vs allatom 0.5847 = -0.036 Pearson (~6% rel); TIGHT, NON-overlapping error bars (torsion max seed 0.5563 < allatom min seed 0.5704); worse on all 4 metrics (RMSE +0.073, MAE +0.063). Giving the model REAL phi/psi/omega + chi via the backbone-spine + chi-path ordering costs more than it gains: the hard segment resets fragment a ~29-residue pocket into ~59 segments (spine fragments + per-residue chi paths + tails) with N/CA repeats, so the edge-window/angle/dihedral streams lose the dense local-contact context the all-atom order provided. Consistent with the project pattern that dense/spatial representations beat structured/sparse ones (cf. the ligand bond graph, which also hurt). DECISION: keep protein_order=allatom.
